name: Pin Input / OTP
summary: Labelled numeric one-time-code field composed from independently clickable and focusable native character inputs with ordered repeated-name submission and bounded progressive enhancement.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Field Wrapper-composed group that owns the complete code label, validation family, and segment relationship without becoming a second value owner.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Visible Field Wrapper label that names the complete code group.

anatomy.name: fields
anatomy.description: Ordered Field Wrapper control region containing only the real native segment inputs.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.description: Real single-character native input; every segment remains independently clickable, focusable, named, validatable, resettable, and submitted.

anatomy.name: description
anatomy.description: Optional persistent guidance composed from Field Wrapper and associated with the group and segments.

anatomy.name: feedback
anatomy.description: Optional current Error, Success, or Warning feedback composed from Field Wrapper for the complete code.

states.name: focusVisible
states.description: Keyboard-focused cell state with the shared field focus hierarchy.

states.name: filled
states.description: Cell state after a character has been entered.

states.name: complete
states.description: Derived state when every real segment contains one accepted character; it does not submit, verify, blur, or announce itself.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Every segment is natively disabled and removed from focus and form submission.

states.name: readOnly
states.description: Every segment remains independently focusable and selectable but cannot be edited.

behavior.name: nativeTextCells
behavior.description: Each cell preserves native text-input semantics and one numeric character. v1 does not infer alphanumeric, masking, or secret-credential behavior.

behavior.name: groupAssociation
behavior.description: One visible label names the complete group while every independently focusable segment has a localized position name such as character 2 of 6.

behavior.name: orderedSubmission
attributes: same non-empty name on every segment
behavior.description: The ordered segment inputs are the only form owners. Static Web submits repeated values under one target-supplied name; targets join the ordered values when a single code string is required. No hidden or mirrored full-code input is allowed.

behavior.name: focusManagement
behavior.description: Accepted typing advances to the next logical segment; Backspace on an empty segment moves to the previous logical segment; horizontal arrows move by visual/logical direction in LTR and RTL. Every segment remains directly clickable and reachable in ordinary Tab order.

behavior.name: pasteCode
behavior.description: The progressive Web adapter filters numeric text and distributes paste or multi-character autofill across the same real inputs, then emits a bubbling native input event from the final changed segment.

behavior.name: completionState
behavior.description: Filled classes and root data-complete are derived from the real segment values. Completion never auto-submits, verifies, blurs, redirects, or creates a live announcement.

behavior.name: ownershipStrategy
behavior.description: Static Web leaves every native segment uncontrolled after its initial value. Stateful adapters may control one ordered segment collection or an uncontrolled initial collection, but must bind the same real inputs and never add a mirrored full-code owner.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Visible label for the complete code group.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Validation presentation for the complete code entry.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Non-empty form name repeated on every ordered segment; Web consumers reconstruct the code with FormData.getAll(name).join('').

properties.name: required
properties.description: Makes every segment natively required and shows the standardized decorative marker once on the complete-code label.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description: Makes every segment read-only while preserving independent focus and selection.

properties.name: invalid
properties.description: Exposes native invalid state for the code cells when Error is active.

properties.name: describedBy
properties.description: Id references for complete-code guidance or current feedback, applied to the group and every segment.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Optional persistent complete-code guidance composed through Field Wrapper.

properties.name: feedback
properties.description: Optional current complete-code feedback; the selected variant determines Error, Success, or Warning semantics.

accessibility: Provide a visible group label for the full one-time-code input.
Use autocomplete="one-time-code" when the field captures verification codes.
Keep every real cell in ordinary Tab order, directly clickable, and independently focusable; logical arrow movement supplements rather than replaces Tab navigation.
Give every segment a localized positional name and associate complete-code guidance and validation with the group and segments.
Mark every segment aria-invalid only for Error; Success and Warning remain valid feedback families.
Support paste and progressive one-time-code autofill distribution without a hidden full-code input.
Do not announce ordinary keystrokes or derived completion; verification results and any live message remain target-owned.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and shared theme.js enhance the real segment inputs with numeric filtering, logical focus movement, paste/autofill distribution, filled state, completion reflection, and reset synchronization; verification remains target-owned.
